description: Land Acquisition - Leloya & Maoya, Laggala-Pallegama D/S Division, Matale District and two amendments of Naula and Yatiyanthota
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land acquisition for the Moragahakanda and Kaluganga Development Project. It contains detailed notices under the Land Acquisition Act describing specific land parcels, their locations, extents, claimants, and cultivators. The content falls squarely under "Land acquisitions, transfers, or disposals" as defined in Type 4 (Land Gazettes), with no government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other specialized categories present.
